title: Run 3
description: Navigate deep space tunnels as the little alien. Defy gravity, leap over crumbling tiles, and explore the galaxy.
controls: Arrow Keys or WASD (Space to Jump)

title: Cookie Clicker
description: Bake trillions of cookies! Hire grandmas, construct alchemy labs, and unlock cosmic cookie upgrades.
controls: Left Click to Bake & Purchase Upgrades

title: Chess Classic
description: The timeless battle of tactics and strategy. Play with grandmaster engines or duel friends.
controls: Click & Drag or Tap to Move Pieces

title: Retro Ping Pong
description: Fast-paced arcade table tennis with gravity wells, bumper obstacles, and action-packed modes.
controls: W / S or Up / Down Arrow Keys

title: Snake Classic
description: The classic arcade snake. Slither, gobble apples, and avoid colliding with walls or your own tail.
